# Features and why to use them

[Example documentation](README.md)

Each row is a capability the example shows, why a developer would use it, and where to learn how.

**Table 1 — Features**

| Capability | Why use it | Framework features | Guide | Run book |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Explore the examples | One place to confirm every example endpoint is alive and to jump to the API and event references, before you start coding against them. | OoBDev.Example.WebApi; OoBDev.AspNetCore.Mvc (OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents) | [guide](user-guide/explore-the-examples.md) | [run book](runbooks/explore-the-examples.md) |
| Chat with a local model | Talk to a model that runs on your machine with no API key and no data leaving it, through the same `IMessageCompletion` interface you would use for a cloud model. | OoBDev.AI.Abstractions (`IMessageCompletion`, `IStreamedCompletion`); OoBDev.Ollama | [guide](user-guide/chat-with-a-local-model.md) | [run book](runbooks/chat-with-a-local-model.md) |
| Hold a conversation with Ollama | Keep context between questions by passing the previous exchange, so follow-ups are understood. | OoBDev.AI.Abstractions (`CompletionRequest.Context`); OoBDev.Ollama | [guide](user-guide/hold-a-conversation.md) | [run book](runbooks/hold-a-conversation.md) |
| Compare two texts with embeddings | Turn text into vectors and measure similarity in process, the basis of semantic search, deduplication and clustering without a remote service. | OoBDev.Onnx.SentenceEmbeddings; OoBDev.AI.Abstractions (`IEmbeddingProvider`) | [guide](user-guide/compare-two-texts.md) | [run book](runbooks/compare-two-texts.md) |
| Ask a question about your own text | Ground answers in your own text (retrieval augmented generation) so the model answers from your passages instead of guessing. | OoBDev.Onnx.SentenceEmbeddings; OoBDev.Ollama; OoBDev.AI.Abstractions | [guide](user-guide/ask-your-own-documents.md) | [run book](runbooks/ask-your-own-documents.md) |
| Check the running service | See the environment, runtime and effective configuration of a running API without shell access; secrets are masked. | OoBDev.AspNetCore.Mvc; Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration | [guide](user-guide/check-the-running-service.md) | [run book](runbooks/check-the-running-service.md) |
| Cache a value | Keep expensive results close by behind one interface; switch between in-memory and Redis by configuration, not code. | OoBDev.Caching (`ICachingProvider`); OoBDev.Microsoft.Caching; OoBDev.Redis.Caching | [guide](user-guide/cache-a-value.md) | [run book](runbooks/cache-a-value.md) |
| Run a read-only query | Let a developer look at data without a path to change it: a parser allows one SELECT, the connection asks for the read-only intent, rows and time are capped, and the login permissions are the real guard. | OoBDev.DacFx (`SelectOnlyGuard`); OoBDev.Example.WebApi (`ReadOnlyQueryRunner`) | [guide](user-guide/run-a-read-only-query.md) | [run book](runbooks/run-a-read-only-query.md) |
| Hash, sign, compare and calculate | Pick the algorithm by key from configuration instead of hard-coding it; the default hash is SHA-512, and signing and vector math are one call each. | OoBDev.System (`IHash`, `IHMACCalculator`); OoBDev.System.Abstractions (`VectorMath`) | [guide](user-guide/use-the-toolbox.md) | [run book](runbooks/use-the-toolbox.md) |
| Query a document and render Markdown | One query language, XPath, reads JSON, YAML, HTML and XML, so extraction code does not change when the format does. | OoBDev.System (`JsonNavigator`); OoBDev.System.Text.Yaml (`YamlNavigator`); OoBDev.System.Text.Html (`HtmlNavigator`); OoBDev.System.Text.Markdown (Markdig) | [guide](user-guide/query-and-render-text.md) | [run book](runbooks/query-and-render-text.md) |
| Store texts and find the closest | The vector store interface hides where vectors live, so the same code runs on SQL Server, Qdrant or in memory and ranks by meaning instead of keywords. | OoBDev.Search.Abstractions (`IVectorStore`); OoBDev.Data.Vectors.SqlStore (`SqlVectorStoreProvider`); OoBDev.SBert.AllMiniLmL6V2 (embeddings) | [guide](user-guide/store-and-search-vectors.md) | [run book](runbooks/store-and-search-vectors.md) |
| Compare a set of vectors | One vector type and four metrics give a quick check of whether embeddings group the way you expect before they go into a store. | OoBDev.System.Abstractions (`Vector`, `VectorMath`, `VectorDistanceMetrics`) | [guide](user-guide/compare-vectors.md) | [run book](runbooks/compare-vectors.md) |
| Label an image without training | CLIP scores any label you type against an image, so new categories need no retraining, and the same model gives a vector for image search. | OoBDev.Vision.ClipVitB32 (zero-shot classifier); OoBDev.Onnx.ImageEmbeddings; OoBDev.Onnx.ImageEmbeddings.Skia | [guide](user-guide/label-an-image.md) | [run book](runbooks/label-an-image.md) |
| Compare sentence embedding models | Models are registered side by side under keys, so switching or comparing models is a change of key, not of code. | OoBDev.SBert.AllMiniLmL6V2; OoBDev.SBert.AllMpnetBaseV2; OoBDev.SBert.NomicEmbedTextV1_5; OoBDev.Onnx.SentenceEmbeddings | [guide](user-guide/compare-embedding-models.md) | [run book](runbooks/compare-embedding-models.md) |
| See what the API just did | Traces and logs leave the service over OTLP, so any dashboard can show them; this page reads the latest back and links into the dashboard for the detail. | OoBDev.OpenTelemetry (OTLP export); Aspire dashboard telemetry API | [guide](user-guide/see-recent-traces.md) | [run book](runbooks/see-recent-traces.md) |
| Render a text template | Generate emails, pages and documents from files named after template, target type and engine, so content changes without code changes. | OoBDev.Text.Templating | [guide](user-guide/render-a-template.md) | [run book](runbooks/render-a-template.md) |
| Send an email through a channel | Send mail through the communications abstraction, so channels can change without touching callers. | OoBDev.Communications; OoBDev.MailKit | [guide](user-guide/send-an-email.md) | [run book](runbooks/send-an-email.md) |
| Put a message on a queue | Hand work to a queue through one interface so RabbitMQ, Service Bus, Storage queues or SQS can be swapped by configuration. | OoBDev.MessageQueue; OoBDev.AsyncApi | [guide](user-guide/queue-a-message.md) | [run book](runbooks/queue-a-message.md) |
| Convert and store a document | Convert and store documents (text, HTML, PDF, markdown) behind one service, so callers never depend on a converter library. | OoBDev.Documents | [guide](user-guide/convert-a-document.md) | [run book](runbooks/convert-a-document.md) |
| Sign in with Keycloak | Authenticate with OpenID Connect and PKCE so the SPA and API handle only tokens, never passwords. | OoBDev.Identity; OoBDev.AspNetCore.JwtAuthentication; Keycloak (authorization code with PKCE) | [guide](user-guide/sign-in.md) | [run book](runbooks/sign-in.md) |
| See the claims on your token | Inspect the claims the API sees on your token, the quickest way to debug roles and rights. | OoBDev.Identity; Keycloak (OIDC, JWT bearer) | [guide](user-guide/see-who-you-are.md) | [run book](runbooks/see-who-you-are.md) |
| Search passages by keyword, meaning and both | See why keyword search misses paraphrases, why embeddings rank everything, and how rank fusion combines them, with the scoring in plain view. | OoBDev.Onnx.SentenceEmbeddings; OoBDev.AI.Abstractions (`IEmbeddingProvider`) | [guide](user-guide/search-three-ways.md) | [run book](runbooks/search-three-ways.md) |
| Open and preview a template | Try a Handlebars template against JSON data and see the output at once, before wiring it into code. | OoBDev.System (`ITemplateEngine`, `FileTemplateSource`); OoBDev.Handlebars | [guide](user-guide/preview-a-template.md) | [run book](runbooks/preview-a-template.md) |
| See the queue channels and received messages | See the configured channels without opening configuration files, and watch what the handler receives. | OoBDev.MessageQueueing; OoBDev.RabbitMq, OoBDev.Microsoft.Azure.StorageAccount | [guide](user-guide/watch-the-queues.md) | [run book](runbooks/watch-the-queues.md) |
| Run a CGI program | See a CGI program answer through the middleware, with its status, without a command line. | OoBDev.AspNetCore.Cgi; OoBDev.AspNetCore.Cgi.OpenApi | [guide](user-guide/run-a-cgi-program.md) | [run book](runbooks/run-a-cgi-program.md) |
| Send a webhook to a channel | See how the host answers a provider call: 204 when processed, 400 for a bad signature, 404 for an unknown channel. | OoBDev.Communications (`IReceiveService`) | [guide](user-guide/send-a-webhook.md) | [run book](runbooks/send-a-webhook.md) |
| Check which rights an endpoint needs | See the authorization model in one place: anonymous, authenticated or application rights, the same on every API surface. | OoBDev.AspNetCore.Abstractions (`[ApplicationRight]`, `IApplicationRightChecker`) | [guide](user-guide/check-your-rights.md) | [run book](runbooks/check-your-rights.md) |
| Review the right audit trail | Answer "who was refused, and for which right" from the durable trail, without reading logs. | OoBDev.AspNetCore.Abstractions (`IApplicationRightChecker`); OoBDev.AspNetCore.EntityFrameworkCore (`TryAddEntityFrameworkRightAudit`) | [guide](user-guide/review-the-right-audit-trail.md) | [run book](runbooks/review-the-right-audit-trail.md) |
| Browse users and roles | Answer "why can this person do that" without opening the Keycloak console; the screen is read-only. | OoBDev.Keycloak (`KeycloakDirectoryReader`); OoBDev.AspNetCore.Abstractions (`IRoleRightMapper`) | [guide](user-guide/browse-users-and-roles.md) | [run book](runbooks/browse-users-and-roles.md) |
| Render a panel from a server-supplied definition | See the framework UI contract rendered by a client that has no knowledge of the form. | OoBDev.UiDefinitions (`UiDefinition`, `ValueValidator`, `FormDefinitionGenerator`) | [guide](user-guide/server-driven-ui.md) | [run book](runbooks/server-driven-ui.md) |
| Schedule a message | Show a due-time event store with a hosted runner: items are leased so two instances never run the same one, and registering the same key again moves the due time. | OoBDev.ComplexEvents (`IScheduleStore`, `ScheduleRunner`); OoBDev.ComplexEvents.Hosting (`ScheduleHost`) | [guide](user-guide/schedule-a-message.md) | [run book](runbooks/schedule-a-message.md) |
